title: update_work answer
description: The memory tool update_work's answer (migration 079): a work item's state, type or priority changed, as a change of the memory. work is its properties now and before those it had; changed names what moved (work_state, work_type, work_priority); summary is what the call gave when the state became done or cancelled, kept in the change's audit row. The state before is kept as a version, the revision moved, history records it (work_changed) and undo puts it back; a repeat answers unchanged true with changed empty, and nothing was written. replayed is always false and dropped_tags empty. Refused (invalid): a memory that is no work item, a state done or cancelled with no summary, a summary with any other change, one over 280 characters or that reads like instructions to an AI client, and a memory whose time has ended; held and retracted for one held for review or marked wrong; conflict for a stale expected_revision. Listed and answered only with memory.tools and memory.work on, and refused (off) with the second off (contracts/README.md 2.1). The JSON in its text content, and on success the same as its structured content; a refusal is isError true with the refusal body.
